recent_changes.description: Created telemetry benchmark documentation, station classification rules, updated API endpoints documentation and brain memory.
Multi-region OSRM real driving route analysis across Bắc Ninh, Long Biên Hà Nội, Mai Sơn Thanh Hóa, and Cẩm Xuyên Hà Tĩnh.

errors_encountered.error: EVCS.vn API exhibits periodic HTTP response latency spikes (up to 5.4s and occasional 10s timeout) under rapid polling
errors_encountered.solution: Documented need for client-side timeout guards and fallback to HERE Maps EV API which maintains strict 260-450ms bounds

errors_encountered.error: HERE Maps EV API exhibits 15-30 minute roaming sync latency for V-GREEN franchised stations
errors_encountered.solution: Documented hybrid telemetry architecture where franchised stations cross-reference EVCS session data

decisions_made.decision: Adopt Hybrid Telemetry Engine: HERE Maps EV API as primary for official VinFast stations; EVCS as fallback/enhancement for franchised V-GREEN stations
decisions_made.reason: Official stations push sub-second OCPP events to HERE and report OUT_OF_SERVICE hardware status. Franchised stations update faster on EVCS due to direct VinFast app session binding.

decisions_made.decision: Rely on OSRM driving distance matrix rather than Haversine straight-line distance for reroute candidates
decisions_made.reason: Haversine causes severe misdirection near rivers, estuaries, and expressways (e.g. 9.5 km straight-line vs 26.3 km driving route in Hà Tĩnh).
